purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt/claims processing system - specifically the hospitalization (nyuin) medical procedure input component
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles medical procedure input for hospitalization (nyuin) cases, including patient information, insurance combination, diagnosis, and medical act entry. It reads/writes SPA (screen parameter area) files and parameter files, performing validation and calculation checks for medical billing.

notable_features: 81 COPY statements referencing external copybooks (.INC files)
Large working storage with extensive flag areas (FLG-AREA)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Large PIC X(30000) and PIC X(60000) data records for SPA communication
verdict.notes: File is 553KB, 13007 lines - a large production program. Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake display. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. Source truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently.
